children: OTTAWA, Sept 4 (Reuters) - Canada's economy lost a net 41,700 jobs in August, mostly in full-time work, and the jobless rate held at the two-year low of 6.4%, Statistics Canada said on Friday.    Employment in the goods producing sector grew by a net 9,800 jobs, largely in manufacturing. The services sector was down by a net 51,500 positions, led by business, building and other support services, as well as wholesale and retail trade.
Unemployment rate       6.4%            6.4%             Participation          65.0%           65.1%     Labor force       22.633 mln      22.669 mln
Aug 2026        Aug 2025     % change     Avg hourly wage      C$38.56         C$37.81       +2.0

NOTE: Analysts surveyed by Reuters had forecast 15,000 new jobs in August, and for the unemployment rate to hold at 6.4%. Hourly wage figures are for permanent employees.    (Reporting by Dale Smith; Editing by Promit Mukherjee)    (( promit.mukherjee@tr.com))
